subject: english
question: What is the author’s central argument regarding renewable energy?

options.text: It is limited to electricity generation

solution: The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. It transforms multiple economic sectors**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **“transforms multiple economic sectors”** means bringing significant changes and improvements to various fields such as agriculture, industry, and transport using renewable energy sources. (कई आर्थिक क्षेत्रों में बदलाव लाना) • **Example:** Renewable energy is used not only for electricity but also in transport (biofuels), irrigation (solar pumps), and industry (solar thermal processing). • The author emphasizes that renewable energy’s impact goes far beyond just power generation, touching employment, rural electrification, industrial processing, and energy autonomy. • Therefore, the central argument is about the broad and transformative role of renewable energy across many sectors, not just one. Therefore, the correct answer is- It transforms multiple economic sectors [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **It is limited to electricity generation** (यह केवल विद्युत उत्पादन तक सीमित है): Suggests renewable energy is only used for making electricity. • **Example:** The passage makes it clear that renewables are used in many sectors beyond just electricity. • **It benefits only rural regions** (यह केवल ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों को लाभ पहुंचाता है): Means rural areas are the sole beneficiaries. • **Example:** The passage mentions industrial and transport uses, showing city and industry benefits as well. • **It replaces all fossil fuels** (यह सभी जीवाश्म ईंधनों को प्रतिस्थापित करता है): Means a complete replacement of fossil fuels. • **Example:** The passage mentions ongoing challenges, not total replacement of fossil fuels. 45:Tdef, The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. To demonstrate heating and cooling applications**.
